attractions.name: Khajjiar Meadow
attractions.description: High-altitude green meadow with a small lake, surrounded by cedar forest and the Dhauladhar mountains; known as the "Mini Switzerland of India". Horse riding, zorbing and nature walks are popular.

attractions.name: Khajji Nag Temple
attractions.description: 12th-century wooden temple dedicated to the serpent deity Khajji Nag, with intricate carvings, beside the meadow.
